documents.title: In the Matter of Jardine Strategic Holdings Limited, Supreme Court of Bermuda (Commercial Court), 2021 Nos. 107-126 - Judgment of Hargun CJ on directions for the appraisal of fair value under section 106 of the Companies Act 1981
documents.publisher: Supreme Court of Bermuda (published by the Government of Bermuda)
documents.why_it_matters: The court's account of the Group's structure before the 2021 amalgamation: Jardine Matheson held about 84.9% of Jardine Strategic, and Jardine Strategic held 59.3% of Jardine Matheson.
